name: Emily Brinehart
source:
She claims to be the Immortal Queen, citing it the will of the "Cosmic Ones".

Emily's patchwork teddy bear, Dichroma, has a "mind of its own," although it's more than obvious it''s just Emily...right?

Speaks in riddles, but they are often little more than inflated nonsense. Being slow to open up, Emily is defensive of something important from before the outbreak...right?

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
